reports.title: Yemen war makes reaching assistance too dangerous for many
reports.summary: More than 280,000 people have now been displaced by fighting in Yemen and many vulnerable people are unable to access lifesaving relief because it is too dangerous to do so, the UN refugee agency (UNHCR) said on Friday.

reports.title: Myanmar’s illicit economy fuels escalating violence, with civilians bearing the brunt
reports.summary: Myanmar’s human rights situation is “catastrophic”, the UN independent expert on the country warned at a press briefing Thursday, as the war spirals with no end in sight.

reports.title: World News in Brief: 5 children killed in Sudan, Haiti hunger emergency, Yemen war update
reports.summary: At least five children were killed and two others injured in a drone attack on a market in Nyala, in Sudan’s South Darfur state, on Monday, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Thursday.

reports.title: Russia drone strike on Ukrainian railway station kills 13
reports.summary: The UN’s top humanitarian official in Ukraine on Thursday condemned a Russian drone attack on the city of Dnipro that killed at least 13 civilians and injured 10 others at its main railway station.

reports.title: Security Council LIVE: Can new technology keep the world’s sea lanes safe?
reports.summary: Cheap drones, autonomous vessels and cyberattacks are changing the threats to the world’s shipping lanes – and the tools to counter them. At an open debate on Thursday, the Security Council is weighing how emerging technologies could both...

reports.title: Civilians in Sudan’s El Obeid trapped between drones and incarceration
reports.summary: Civilians in Sudan’s El Obeid live in constant fear of drone attacks by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) and of a wave of arbitrary arrests by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), UN-appointed independent investigators said on Wednesday.

reports.title: UN human rights chief urges better protection of civilians in conflicts
reports.summary: Youth-led protests against corruption and inequality in Serbia, Bangladesh, Nepal and Madagascar reflect a growing demand for reinforcing human rights around the world, UN human rights chief Volker Türk said at a press briefing on Wednesda...

reports.title: Backing for UN call to end Cuba embargo falls to 20-year low
reports.summary: The UN General Assembly on Wednesday called for the 34th time for an end to the US economic, commercial and financial embargo on Cuba – but with the weakest backing for the resolution in two decades.

reports.title: Protecting the storytellers: Women journalists on the frontline of conflict
reports.summary: As online abuse, gender-based attacks and impunity ramp up the threats to women reporting from crisis zones, journalists and UN leaders are calling for urgent action to protect those who document conflict.

reports.title: General Assembly weighs US embargo against Cuba ahead of 34th vote
reports.summary: The General Assembly opened its annual debate on the US economic embargo against Cuba on Tuesday. On Wednesday, 28 October, Member States will vote for the 34th time on a resolution calling for it to end.

reports.title: Gaza: Families brace for fourth winter in tents as aid operations remain stymied
reports.summary: Families in Gaza are bracing for a fourth winter in tents and makeshift shelters as UN aid operations face mounting obstacles, with transport suspended on Tuesday due to Israel’s closure of the key Kerem Shalom crossing for election day.

reports.title: Security Council LIVE: Women and girls face greater dangers in war
reports.summary: From Gaza to Yemen, women and girls are facing ever greater dangers this year simply surviving in war zones. The Security Council meets Tuesday to debate the best way to improve security for women caught up in conflict.

reports.title: World News in Brief: ‘No safe place in Ukraine’, IAEA calls for Iran nuclear inspections, Kenya hosts thousands of Ethiopians fleeing clashes
reports.summary: The UN refugee agency (UNHCR) on Tuesday urged continued international support for Ukraine’s population as Russian airstrikes intensify and humanitarian needs grow in advance of another bitterly cold winter.

reports.title: The environmental risks from attacks on data centres
reports.summary: Data centres are increasingly being targeted during conflicts, posing new and poorly understood pollution risks to the communities they are frequently located in. In this post Eoghan Darbyshire examines the trend, and what we know of the r...

reports.title: World News in Brief: Ethiopians flee to Kenya amidst renewed conflict, new head of UN’s food programme, UN mission in Somalia concludes
reports.summary: Around 36,600 people have fled into northern Kenya following an uptick in fighting on the Ethiopian side of the border.

reports.title: Women and girls’ share of civilian war deaths doubles since 2021
reports.summary: War is growing deadlier for women and girls, who accounted for one in four of the more than 37,000 civilians killed in armed conflict last year – double their share in 2021 – according to major UN report released Monday.

reports.title: Ukraine: Investigators find Russia committed war crimes by targeting civilians
reports.summary: Top human rights experts investigating Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine said on Monday that the Russian authorities had committed war crimes and crimes against humanity by attacking civilians and vital energy infrastructure, among o...

reports.title: In Egypt, Guterres warns against Iran-US escalation
reports.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres called for dialogue and diplomacy to end the war between Iran and the United States in remarks on Monday to journalists in Cairo, Egypt.

reports.title: World News in Brief: Iran nuclear inspections, deadly church attack in Jordan, El Fasher – one year on
reports.summary: The head of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), Rafael Grossi, called on Friday for a swift return of inspectors to Iran, warning of growing fragility in the global nuclear non-proliferation regime.

reports.title: West Bank: Guterres alarmed as Israel imposes sweeping closures after deadly Hebron attack
reports.summary: The UN said on Friday it was “extremely alarmed” by intensifying violence in the occupied West Bank, as Israel moved to seal off the territory following a deadly attack on its soldiers in Hebron.

reports.title: Sudan: Drone strikes killed at least 306 people in three weeks
reports.summary: UN human rights chief Volker Türk on Friday strongly condemned an escalation in drone strikes across Sudan this month, which killed at least 306 people and injured hundreds more in the first three weeks of October alone.

reports.title: Yemen: Deepening concerns for Taiz City as aid is blocked from entering
reports.summary: Aid agencies warned on Friday of the fast-developing humanitarian emergency inside Taiz City in Yemen, which has been encircled by de facto Houthi forces fighting government troops along the country’s west coast.

reports.title: World News in Brief: Russian attacks intensify, UN team tours West Bank, ‘unlawful’ elderly deaths
reports.summary: Long-range Russian attacks across Ukraine are intensifying, including in Kyiv, causing at least 14 civilian deaths and 78 injuries overnight into Thursday, as UN agencies continue to provide aid.

reports.title: ‘Connect the dots’ between street protests and global turmoil, urges Guterres
reports.summary: The international community must combat inequality and stop wars from expanding to ensure a safer world for all, the UN Secretary-General said on Thursday.

reports.title: ‘Ominous start’ to West Bank olive harvest amid settler attacks
reports.summary: The use of live ammunition, arson and the destruction of centuries-old olive trees have marked the opening weeks of this year’s harvest in the occupied West Bank.

reports.title: World News in Brief: Aid for Ethiopia, Abyei drone strikes condemned, extreme heat and newborn health
reports.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) is scaling up emergency health response operations across Afar, Amhara and Tigray in Ethiopia to address growing humanitarian and health needs resulting from ongoing hostilities.

reports.title: Summit in Samarkand, a boon for child wellbeing and health
reports.summary: Representatives from across the international community are meeting in Samarkand, Uzbekistan, to ensure that children everywhere can thrive in a world marred by war, climate chaos and other fundamental challenges.

reports.title: Sudan conflict: Peace efforts resume to end ‘drone war’ fuelling humanitarian crisis
reports.summary: Talks to halt the fighting in Sudan and alleviate the humanitarian crisis there continued in Geneva on Wednesday, where nearly two dozen countries convened to discuss a pathway to a ceasefire and transition to peaceful governance that repr...

reports.title: AI on track to ‘crowd out’ human decision-making in warfare
reports.summary: Artificial intelligence is already being widely used on the battlefield, and the role of human judgment in military operations is shrinking rapidly, the head of the UN’s independent disarmament research institute warned on Tuesday.

reports.title: As Sudan war spills into Central African Republic, UN warns against early peacekeeper exit
reports.summary: The UN warned on Tuesday against a premature withdrawal of its peacekeepers as the war in Sudan spills over into the Central African Republic (CAR).

reports.title: Yemen war continues to force families from homes amid hunger and disease
reports.summary: More than 250,000 people have now fled renewed fighting in Yemen, the UN said on Tuesday, citing particular concern for those sheltering in the southwestern city of Taiz and the wider governorate, where access is “essentially blocked”.

reports.title: Nature, peace and security at COP17

reports.summary: Joint civil society statement on the environment, peace and security delivered to the UN General Assembly's First Committee that challenges the forum to fully engage on the environmental dimensions of the peace, security and disarmament to...

reports.summary: This report analyses how governments address military emissions and armed conflict impacts in UNFCCC Nationally Determined Contributions, the national climate plans that all countries have to submit to the UNFCCC. Military emissions are mi...

reports.summary: Our new Military Emissions Gap dataset reveals that, in the face of the accelerating climate crisis and rising military spending, military emissions reporting to the UNFCCC is getting worse. Many countries reporting is becoming less transp...
